projects_core.name: projects_core
projects_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  unics_id,
  title,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  total_cost,
  ec_max_contribution,
  acronym,
  ec_ref,
  framework_program
FROM projects
projects_core.description: Normalized projection of the projects table exposing project identifiers, title, time span and financial measures. Cleans/renames columns for downstream joins and filters.
validated_on: Show the total costs of all projects

project_financials_by_project.name: project_financials_by_project
project_financials_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  SUM(p.total_cost) AS sum_total_cost,
  SUM(p.ec_max_contribution) AS sum_ec_max_contribution,
  MIN(p.start_date) AS min_start_date,
  MAX(p.end_date) AS max_end_date
FROM
  projects_core p
GROUP BY
  p.unics_id
project_financials_by_project.description: Aggregated financial measures per project. Produces raw sums/aggregates at project level (keeps project as grain so aggregates are reusable for many queries). Useful when project-level cost rollups or comparisons are needed.

project_title_cohort.name: project_title_cohort
project_title_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title
FROM
  projects_core p
project_title_cohort.description: Simple selectable cohort of projects with their key identifiers and titles to support exact-title lookup or title keyword filtering.
validated_on: Show total cost of project with title Theseus

project_financials_by_id.name: project_financials_by_id
project_financials_by_id.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  p.cordis_ref,
  p.ec_ref
FROM projects p
project_financials_by_id.description: Denormalized project financials and reference identifiers (keeps raw numeric measures) for joining to other dimensions like programmes or members when needed.

project_membership_basic.name: project_membership_basic
project_membership_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.activity_type AS activity_type,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3
FROM
  project_members pm
JOIN
  projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_membership_basic.description: Denormalized view of project membership linking projects to member institutions and basic member attributes; one row per project-member association enabling filters by member attributes and joins back to project core.

institutions_core.name: institutions_core
institutions_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.acronym,
  i.country_id,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  i.website,
  i.grid_id
FROM institutions i
institutions_core.description: Canonical institution-level relation exposing institution identifiers, names, country and geocode region for geographic and organizational filters and joins.
counter_examples: Show names of institutions from France or Germany

project_membership_denorm.name: project_membership_denorm
project_membership_denorm.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3,
  pm.latitude AS latitude,
  pm.longitude AS longitude
FROM project_members pm
LEFT JOIN projects p ON pm.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN institutions i ON pm.institution_id = i.unics_id
project_membership_denorm.description: Denormalized one-row-per-project-member joining project_members to projects and institutions (when available). Exposes member role, institution id, contribution and geographic columns to support queries that filter projects by membership attributes.

projects_by_start_year.name: projects_by_start_year
projects_by_start_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.start_date,
  COALESCE(p.start_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer) AS start_year
FROM projects p
projects_by_start_year.description: Cohort of projects annotated by start_year derived from start_date to make year-based filtering easy. One row per project.

project_membership_wide.name: project_membership_wide
project_membership_wide.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  pm.country AS "project_members.country",
  pm.ec_contribution AS "project_members.ec_contribution",
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id",
  p.title AS "projects.title",
  p.start_date AS "projects.start_date"
FROM project_members pm
LEFT JOIN projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_membership_wide.description: Denormalized rows of project members joined to their projects and institutions to expose project-member-institution attributes useful for filtering/grouping by participant, country or institution.

project_programme_link.name: project_programme_link
project_programme_link.body_sql:
SELECT
  pp.project AS "project_programmes.project",
  pp.programme AS "project_programmes.programme",
  p.code AS "programmes.code",
  p.title AS "programmes.title",
  pr.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id",
  pr.start_date AS "projects.start_date"
FROM
  project_programmes pp
LEFT JOIN
  programmes p
    ON pp.programme = p.code
LEFT JOIN
  projects pr
    ON pp.project = pr.unics_id
project_programme_link.description: Mapping of projects to their programme(s) and programme metadata; one row per project-programme association to enable grouping or filtering by programme.

projects_rowlevel.name: projects_rowlevel
projects_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id                                 AS unics_id,
  COALESCE(pc.title, p.title)                AS title,
  p.start_date                               AS start_date,
  p.end_date                                 AS end_date,
  p.start_year                               AS start_year,
  p.end_year                                 AS end_year,
  p.ec_fund_scheme                           AS ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program                        AS framework_program,
  p.principal_investigator                   AS principal_investigator
FROM
  projects p
LEFT JOIN
  project_title_cohort pc
ON
  p.unics_id = pc.unics_id
projects_rowlevel.description: One canonical row per project with normalized/renamed project attributes useful for filtering and joining. Exposes project identifiers, dates, titles, funding and PI for downstream filters and aggregates.
validated_on: Show the project title and member name where the member has a partner role

project_members_rowlevel.name: project_members_rowlevel
project_members_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.country,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.latitude,
  pm.longitude
FROM project_members pm
project_members_rowlevel.description: One row per project member (participant) linking member attributes and financial contribution to the project. Useful for cohort selection by country, institution, contribution and role.
validated_on: Find member name and role code of project members in project with acronym GTBB

projects_with_programs_and_topics.name: projects_with_programs_and_topics
projects_with_programs_and_topics.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  pp.programme        AS programme,
  pt.topic            AS topic,
  psa.subject_area    AS subject_area
FROM projects p
-- join to project_programmes: zero, one or many programmes per project
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp ON pp.project = p.unics_id
-- join to project_topics: zero, one or many topics per project
LEFT JOIN project_topics pt ON pt.project = p.unics_id
-- join to project_subject_areas: zero, one or many subject areas per project
LEFT JOIN project_subject_areas psa ON psa.project = p.unics_id
projects_with_programs_and_topics.description: Denormalized view linking projects to their programme(s), topic(s) and subject_area(s). One row per project-programme-topic-subject_area combination to support faceted filtering and grouping by these classifications.

institutions_location_tokens.name: institutions_location_tokens
institutions_location_tokens.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  fld.location_field,
  fld.location_token
FROM institutions AS i,
LATERAL (
  -- produce tokens from multiple location-related fields; lift literals out if needed
  SELECT 'institutions_name' AS location_field, regexp_replace(lower(token), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS location_token FROM regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(i.institutions_name, ''), E'\\s+') AS token
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'acronym' AS location_field, regexp_replace(lower(token), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS location_token FROM regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(i.acronym, ''), E'\\s+') AS token
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'short_name' AS location_field, regexp_replace(lower(token), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS location_token FROM regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(i.short_name, ''), E'\\s+') AS token
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'website' AS location_field, regexp_replace(lower(token), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS location_token FROM regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(i.website, ''), E'\\s+') AS token
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'grid_id' AS location_field, regexp_replace(lower(token), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS location_token FROM regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(i.grid_id, ''), E'\\s+') AS token
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'geocode_regions_3' AS location_field, regexp_replace(lower(token), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS location_token FROM regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(i.geocode_regions_3, ''), E'[;,\\|\\/]') AS token
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'country_name' AS location_field, regexp_replace(lower(token), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS location_token
    FROM (
      SELECT c.country_name
      FROM countries c
      WHERE c.unics_id = i.country_id
    ) AS cc, regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(cc.country_name, ''), E'\\s+') AS token
) AS fld
WHERE coalesce(fld.location_token, '') <> ''
institutions_location_tokens.description: Tokenized/denormalized location tokens for institutions to support flexible text/location matching (one token per row).

projects_institutions_membership.name: projects_institutions_membership
projects_institutions_membership.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role",
  pm.ec_contribution AS "project_members.ec_contribution",
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS "project_members.geocode_regions_3",
  pm.region_name AS "project_members.region_name"
FROM
  project_members pm
projects_institutions_membership.description: Denormalized relation linking project_members rows to their institution identity key and basic project_member attributes. Useful for questions combining projects and institution cohorts, counts of participations, or filtering institutions by member attributes.
counter_examples: Show names of institutions which are not from France

people_normalized.name: people_normalized
people_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.full_name
FROM
  people p
people_normalized.description: Canonical people table exposing person id and full name for joins to project principal investigators.
validated_on: Show the full name of people being investigators in projects that began in 2014
Show me the number of projects where Thomas Bell was principal investigator

project_pi_join.name: project_pi_join
project_pi_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.principal_investigator AS principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM
  projects p
LEFT JOIN
  people pe
ON
  p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
project_pi_join.description: Denormalized join of projects to their principal investigator's person row. One row per project (project-level grain) with PI attributes included.

project_principal_investigators.name: project_principal_investigators
project_principal_investigators.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.title AS project_title,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  pi.unics_id AS principal_investigator_unics_id,
  pi.full_name AS principal_investigator_full_name
FROM
  projects p
LEFT JOIN people pi
  ON pi.unics_id = p.principal_investigator
project_principal_investigators.description: Denormalized mapping of projects to their principal investigator persons (one row per project) to quickly answer who is PI for each project and allow filtering by project attributes.

project_subject_area_links.name: project_subject_area_links
project_subject_area_links.body_sql:
SELECT
  psa.project AS project,
  psa.subject_area AS subject_area,
  sa.title AS subject_area_title
FROM
  project_subject_areas psa
LEFT JOIN
  subject_areas sa
ON
  psa.subject_area = sa.code
project_subject_area_links.description: Denormalized linkage between projects and subject area codes and titles. One row per project-subject_area association; includes subject area code and title to support filtering by subject area name.

subject_areas_dim.name: subject_areas_dim
subject_areas_dim.body_sql:
SELECT
  sa.code AS code,
  sa.title AS title,
  sa.description AS description
FROM subject_areas sa
subject_areas_dim.description: Canonical subject area dimension: one row per subject area code with title and description to match by code or title.
counter_examples: What different research domains do exist?

project_subject_area_links_20.name: project_subject_area_links_20
project_subject_area_links_20.body_sql:
SELECT
  psp.project AS project,
  psp.subject_area AS subject_area
FROM project_subject_areas psp
project_subject_area_links_20.description: Project-to-subject_area link rows: one row per project-subject association exposing project id and the subject area identifier (as stored) for joins to project and subject area dimension.

projects_core_21.name: projects_core_21
projects_core_21.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id",
  p.start_date AS "projects.start_date",
  p.end_date AS "projects.end_date",
  p.start_year AS "projects.start_year",
  p.end_year AS "projects.end_year",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym",
  p.title AS "projects.title",
  p.ec_ref AS "projects.ec_ref",
  p.framework_program AS "projects.framework_program"
FROM projects p

semantic_filters.end_date: IS NOT NULL  -- keep only projects that have an end_date when desired; final query can override

projects_core_21.description: One-row-per-project core project attributes useful for time and id-based filtering (dates, ids, identifiers, and basic funding fields).

project_topics_link.name: project_topics_link
project_topics_link.body_sql:
SELECT
  pt.project AS "project_topics.project",
  pt.topic AS "project_topics.topic"
FROM project_topics pt
project_topics_link.description: Mapping of projects to topic codes: one row per project-topic association. Useful for finding topics linked to any project cohort.

topics_canonical.name: topics_canonical
topics_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code                         AS "topics.code",
  t.title                        AS "topics.title",
  t.rcn                          AS "topics.rcn"
FROM topics t
topics_canonical.description: Canonical topic list with stable identifiers and titles for lookup and presentation.

projects_rowlevel_24.name: projects_rowlevel_24
projects_rowlevel_24.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.acronym AS acronym,

  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,

projects_rowlevel_24.description: One row per project exposing core project attributes and timeframe to serve as a reusable project cohort for filtering and joins.

project_topics_link_25.name: project_topics_link_25
project_topics_link_25.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM

project_topics_link_25.description: Project-to-topic link rows: one row per project-topic association, suitable for finding topics associated with project cohorts.

topics_canonical_26.name: topics_canonical_26
topics_canonical_26.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,

FROM topics t
topics_canonical_26.description: Canonical topic metadata: one row per topic code exposing human-readable title and reference identifiers.

project_members_core.name: project_members_core

project_members_core.description: Normalized/cleaned project member rows exposing member identifying columns, geographic and institution links, and financial contribution fields. Keeps one row per project-member record as stored.

projects_core_28.name: projects_core_28
projects_core_28.body_sql:
SELECT

LEFT JOIN project_title_cohort pt

validated_on: Count the projects that started in 2016

Find the id of projects with at least 100 members

project_member_country_cohort.name: project_member_country_cohort
project_member_country_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT

  pm.project,
  -- lift literal mapping behavior out of view: use pm.country directly
  pm.country AS country
FROM project_members pm
project_member_country_cohort.description: Cohort view of project-member rows annotated with the member's country to support queries that filter projects by member country. One row per project_members.unics_id.

countries_core.name: countries_core
countries_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.unics_id AS unics_id,
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  c.country_code2 AS country_code2,
  c.country_code3 AS country_code3,

FROM
  countries c
countries_core.description: Canonical projection of countries with multiple code variants and the primary key for joins and filtering by country name or codes.

Show me the country of all institutes.

project_members_minimal.name: project_members_minimal
project_members_minimal.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.country AS country
FROM
  project_members pm
project_members_minimal.description: Project member rows exposing institution_id and the free-text country reported on the member row. Useful to find institutions that appear as project participants from a country name even if institution.country_id differs.

institutions_core_32.name: institutions_core_32
institutions_core_32.body_sql:
SELECT
  institutions.institutions_name AS institutions_name,
  institutions.unics_id AS unics_id,
  institutions.country_id AS country_id,
  institutions.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3,
  institutions.acronym AS acronym,
  institutions.short_name AS short_name,
  institutions.website AS website
FROM institutions
institutions_core_32.description: One-row-per-institution canonical projection exposing institution identifiers, name, and its country foreign key and geocodes for downstream filtering and joins. Keeps raw measures (no aggregation) and normalizes key columns to their source names.
counter_examples: Show me the country of all institutes.

institutions_with_country.name: institutions_with_country
institutions_with_country.body_sql:
SELECT
  institutions.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id",
  institutions.institutions_name AS "institutions.institutions_name",
  institutions.country_id AS "institutions.country_id",
  countries.unics_id AS "countries.unics_id",
  countries.country_name AS "countries.country_name",
  countries.country_code2 AS "countries.country_code2",
  countries.country_code3 AS "countries.country_code3",
  countries.geocode_country_code AS "countries.geocode_country_code"
FROM institutions
LEFT JOIN countries
  ON institutions.country_id = countries.unics_id
institutions_with_country.description: Denormalized institution rows joined to the countries table to expose country name and country codes alongside each institution for geographic filtering and display.

project_participation_by_institution.name: project_participation_by_institution
project_participation_by_institution.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id AS project_unics_id",
  p.start_year AS "projects.start_year",
  pm.ec_contribution AS "project_members.ec_contribution",
  i.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id AS institution_unics_id",
  i.country_id AS "institutions.country_id"
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN
  institutions i
  ON pm.institution_id = i.unics_id
project_participation_by_institution.description: Denormalized view joining projects to their project_members/institutions so one can analyze projects together with participating institutions and member-level contributions. One row per project-member association.

projects_with_principal_investigator.name: projects_with_principal_investigator
projects_with_principal_investigator.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.total_cost,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
projects_with_principal_investigator.description: Projects joined with principal investigator (person) basic info; one row per project with PI id and name to support questions that need project + PI.

projects_rowlevel_with_costs.name: projects_rowlevel_with_costs
projects_rowlevel_with_costs.body_sql:
SELECT
  pc.unics_id AS unics_id,
  -- prefer canonical total_cost from projects_core; fall back to aggregated sum_total_cost or project_financials_by_id.total_cost
  COALESCE(pc.total_cost, pfb.sum_total_cost, pfi.total_cost) AS total_cost
FROM
  projects_core pc
  LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project pfb ON pfb.unics_id = pc.unics_id
  LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_id pfi ON pfi.unics_id = pc.unics_id
WHERE
  pc.unics_id IS NOT NULL
projects_rowlevel_with_costs.description: One row per project, canonicalizing cost-related fields and exposing project identifiers and cost measures for use in cohorts and aggregations. Filters out rows where unics_id is NULL to ensure stable row grain.

project_members_rowlevel_37.name: project_members_rowlevel_37
project_members_rowlevel_37.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  -- prefer member_name from project_members if present, else from joined project_membership_basic; lift literals out
  COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.member_name, ''), NULLIF(pmb.member_name, '')) AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  project_membership_basic pmb
ON
  pm.project = pmb.project
  AND pm.unics_id = pmb.unics_id
project_members_rowlevel_37.description: One row per project member, exposing membership link to project and member identifying attributes. Cleans member_name by excluding NULLs at query time (do not filter here to keep view general).

project_members_raw.name: project_members_raw
project_members_raw.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id::integer AS unics_id,
  pm.project::integer AS project,
  -- prefer explicit institution_id from project_members; fall back to NULL if absent
  pm.institution_id::integer AS institution_id,
  pm.member_role::text AS member_role,
  pm.country::text AS country,
  pm.ec_contribution::double precision AS ec_contribution,
  -- canonicalized geocode_regions_3: prefer project_members value, else institution's geocode if joined (lifted literal: none)
  pm.geocode_regions_3::text AS geocode_regions_3
FROM project_members pm
project_members_raw.description: Row-level cohort of project_members records with canonicalized important id and location columns retained. Use this as the base for counts, filters by project, institution, country, role, or geocode.

members_count_per_project.name: members_count_per_project
members_count_per_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pm.unics_id) AS distinct_member_unics_count,
  COUNT(*) AS member_row_count
FROM
  project_membership_basic pm
GROUP BY
  pm.project
members_count_per_project.description: Aggregate counts of distinct project member IDs per project. Provides raw counts that downstream queries can filter or threshold.

projects_row_level.name: projects_row_level
projects_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  -- canonicalize funding scheme: prefer projects.ec_fund_scheme, fallback to projects_core.framework_program,
  -- lift literals: treat empty string as NULL
  CASE
    WHEN p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p.ec_fund_scheme) <> '' THEN p.ec_fund_scheme
    WHEN pc.framework_program IS NOT NULL AND btrim(pc.framework_program) <> '' THEN pc.framework_program
    ELSE NULL
  END AS ec_fund_scheme,
  -- title: prefer projects_core.title (canonical project title), fallback to projects.title
  COALESCE(pc.title, p.title) AS title,
  -- dates and years: prefer values from projects_core (pc) if present, else from projects (p)
  pc.start_date,
  pc.end_date,
  pc.start_year,
  pc.end_year
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_core pc
  ON p.unics_id = pc.unics_id
projects_row_level.description: One row per project with canonicalized funding scheme column and basic project identifiers and dates. Exposes project-level attributes usable for counts, filters, and joins to funding scheme metadata.

funding_schemes_core.name: funding_schemes_core
funding_schemes_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code,
  fs.title
FROM
  funding_schemes fs
funding_schemes_core.description: Canonical list of funding schemes exposing the scheme code and human title for joining and presentation.

projects_per_funding_scheme.name: projects_per_funding_scheme
projects_per_funding_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
  COUNT(*) AS project_count
FROM
  projects p
GROUP BY
  p.ec_fund_scheme
projects_per_funding_scheme.description: Aggregated count of projects per funding scheme code. One row per funding scheme with raw project_count measure (does not tie in funding_schemes title).

projects_by_framework_program.name: projects_by_framework_program
projects_by_framework_program.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(p.framework_program, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS framework_program,
  COUNT(*) AS projects_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(p.total_cost, 0)) AS total_cost_sum,
  SUM(COALESCE(p.ec_max_contribution, 0)) AS ec_max_contribution_sum
FROM
  projects_core p
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(p.framework_program, 'UNSPECIFIED')
projects_by_framework_program.description: Aggregated measures of projects grouped by framework_program. Returns counts and sum of financial measures per framework program. Useful for breakdowns of costs by program.

project_basic_metadata.name: project_basic_metadata
project_basic_metadata.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  COALESCE(pc.title, p.title) AS title,
  pp.programme,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  COALESCE(p.total_cost, pf.total_cost) AS total_cost
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_title_cohort pc
  ON pc.unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_id pf
  ON pf.unics_id = p.unics_id
project_basic_metadata.description: Denormalized basic project metadata joining projects to programmes and project_programmes where available. Exposes project id, programme code, titles, and key financial/time columns to support queries that need project + programme context.

project_with_principal_investigator.name: project_with_principal_investigator
project_with_principal_investigator.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
project_with_principal_investigator.description: Denormalized project rows joined to the principal investigator's people record (if present), exposing project identifiers, timeline, title and PI name. Helpful for questions combining project temporal filters with PI information.

projects_core_years.name: projects_core_years
projects_core_years.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  COALESCE(p.title, tc.title) AS title,
  -- lift any literals out: no literals here
  -- normalized years: prefer projects_core's start_year/end_year, fall back to extracting year from dates if null
  COALESCE(p.start_year,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.min_start_date)::integer) AS start_year,
  COALESCE(p.end_year,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.max_end_date)::integer) AS end_year,
  -- duration in years: end_year - start_year (can be null if either is null)
  (COALESCE(p.end_year,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.max_end_date)::integer)
   -
   COALESCE(p.start_year,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.min_start_date)::integer)
  )::integer AS duration_years
FROM projects_core p
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project pf
  ON p.unics_id = pf.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_title_cohort tc
  ON p.unics_id = tc.unics_id
projects_core_years.description: Canonical project-level row with basic identifiers and normalized year columns (start_year and end_year) and a computed duration in years (end_year - start_year). Keeps one row per project.

topic_rows.name: topic_rows
topic_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  t.title AS title
FROM
  topics t
topic_rows.description: Row-level cohort of topic records (one row per topic) exposing key id and title for filtering and selection.

topics_row_level.name: topics_row_level
topics_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  t.title AS title
FROM
  topics t
topics_row_level.description: Row-level canonical view of the topics table exposing topic id and title for filtering and joins.

topic_titles_searchable.name: topic_titles_searchable
topic_titles_searchable.body_sql:
SELECT
  code,
  title,
  lower(title) AS title_lower
FROM topics
topic_titles_searchable.description: Normalized projection of topics that exposes a lowercase title for case-insensitive search and preserves original title and code.

people_projects_join.name: people_projects_join
people_projects_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id                                                     AS project_unics_id,
  p.principal_investigator                                       AS principal_investigator_unics_id,
  p.acronym                                                      AS project_acronym,
  p.title                                                        AS project_title,
  p.start_year                                                   AS start_year,
  p.end_year                                                     AS end_year
FROM
  projects p
WHERE
  p.principal_investigator IS NOT NULL
people_projects_join.description: Denormalized relation linking people to the projects where they are the principal investigator (one row per project where a principal_investigator is present). Exposes both person and project keys and basic project metadata for filtering/aggregation.

people_cleaned.name: people_cleaned
people_cleaned.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  NULLIF(trim(p.full_name), '') AS full_name
FROM
  people p
WHERE
  p.unics_id IS NOT NULL

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filter; empty strings normalized to NULL

people_cleaned.description: Normalized projection of people table exposing person identifier and a cleaned canonical full name (trims whitespace and treats empty strings as NULL); keeps one row per person.

project_member_persons.name: project_member_persons
project_member_persons.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.member_short_name,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.country
FROM project_members pm

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filter; exposes full set of project member rows

project_member_persons.description: Denormalized mapping of project members to their person/institution identifiers and names. Useful for queries that need people associated with projects or member roles; one row per project_members.unics_id (project member record).

projects_rowlevel_53.name: projects_rowlevel_53
projects_rowlevel_53.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.total_cost,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.ec_call,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program,
  p.ec_ref,
  p.cordis_ref
FROM projects p
projects_rowlevel_53.description: Canonical row-level projection of the projects table exposing identifiers, cost measures, dates and key attributes. Useful as the base cohort for filters by cost, date, programme, or identifiers.

projects_with_principal_and_pi_name.name: projects_with_principal_and_pi_name
projects_with_principal_and_pi_name.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.total_cost,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
projects_with_principal_and_pi_name.description: Denormalized view joining projects to principal investigator (person) basic info. One row per project with PI id and name exposed for filtering or display.

project_membership_by_project.name: project_membership_by_project
project_membership_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.member_short_name AS member_short_name,
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3
FROM project_members pm
JOIN projects p ON p.unics_id = pm.project
project_membership_by_project.description: Row-level view of project_members joined with projects to expose member-level financial contribution and institutional linkage per project member. Useful for questions needing member contributions or institution-level breakdowns for projects.

projects_basic_financials.name: projects_basic_financials
projects_basic_financials.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM
  projects p
projects_basic_financials.description: Per-project financial summary exposing the raw total_cost and ec_max_contribution for each project. Although grouped, this view returns one row per project (no further aggregation) to support reuse for thresholds, rankings and joins.

projects_with_program_and_principal.name: projects_with_program_and_principal
projects_with_program_and_principal.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  -- lift literal: if you want to choose project_financials_by_id vs projects_core total_cost, adjust outside the view
  COALESCE(pf.total_cost, p.total_cost) AS total_cost,
  pp.programme AS programme,
  p.principal_investigator AS principal_investigator
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_id pf ON pf.unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_with_program_and_principal.description: Denormalized view joining projects to programme code and principal investigator id, exposing project identifiers, title, financials and linkage to programmes and principal person id to support filters and richer queries.

project_member_rows.name: project_member_rows
project_member_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS project,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3
FROM project_members pm
project_member_rows.description: One row per project-member relationship exposing membership attributes (role, name, institution linkage, geographic and contribution fields). Useful as a base cohort for filtering members by role, country, institution, or contribution.

project_member_project_join.name: project_member_project_join
project_member_project_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project                           AS project_unics_id,
  p.title                              AS project_title,
  pm.unics_id                          AS member_unics_id,
  pm.member_name                       AS member_name,
  pm.member_role                       AS member_role,
  pm.institution_id                    AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution                   AS ec_contribution
FROM project_members pm
JOIN projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_member_project_join.description: Denormalized view joining project rows to their member rows producing one row per project-member with project title and member details. Useful for queries that need project attributes alongside member attributes (filter by member role, aggregate counts of members per project, etc.).

institutions_with_country_id.name: institutions_with_country_id
institutions_with_country_id.body_sql:
SELECT
  unics_id,
  institutions_name,
  country_id
FROM institutions
WHERE country_id IS NOT NULL
institutions_with_country_id.description: All institution rows that have a non-null country_id. Basic cohort of institutions with an assigned country reference.

institution_with_country_name.name: institution_with_country_name
institution_with_country_name.body_sql:
SELECT
  institutions.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id",
  institutions.institutions_name AS "institutions.institutions_name",
  institutions.country_id AS "institutions.country_id",
  countries.country_name AS "countries.country_name"
FROM
  institutions
JOIN
  countries
ON
  institutions.country_id = countries.unics_id

semantic_filters.countries.unics_id: IS NOT NULL (implicit via inner join)

institution_with_country_name.description: Denormalized view joining institutions to countries to expose each institution with its country_name. Excludes institutions without a matching country.

institutions_with_country_62.name: institutions_with_country_62
institutions_with_country_62.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.country_id,
  c.country_name
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country_62.description: Denormalized view joining institutions to countries to provide institution-level country name. Includes all institutions; country_name is NULL when there is no matching country.

countries_basic_lookup.name: countries_basic_lookup
countries_basic_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  c.country_code2 AS country_code2,
  c.country_code3 AS country_code3,
  c.unics_id AS unics_id
FROM
  countries c
countries_basic_lookup.description: Simple lookup cohort of countries with identifying names and standard codes for filtering and joins (exposes name and codes).

funding_schemes_rows.name: funding_schemes_rows
funding_schemes_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code,
  fs.title,
  NULL::text AS description
FROM
  funding_schemes fs
funding_schemes_rows.description: One row per funding scheme exposing its primary key and descriptive fields for filtering and lookup.

programmes_core.name: programmes_core
programmes_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.code AS code,
  p.rcn AS rcn,
  p.title AS title,
  p.short_name AS short_name,
  p.parent AS parent
FROM
  programmes p
programmes_core.description: Normalized projection of the programmes table exposing canonical programme identifiers and descriptive fields used for filtering and display.

project_member_with_project.name: project_member_with_project
project_member_with_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role",
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id as project_unics_id",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym"
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  projects p
    ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_member_with_project.description: Denormalized view joining project members to projects (one row per project member) to support queries that filter members by project attributes (e.g., project acronym).
